versions.name: Charles E. Parish Reservation
versions.summary: A Middle Tennessee Council reservation near Rock Island on the Cumberland Plateau, used by troops and Webelos dens for weekend camping, camporees, and overnighters, with a multi-purpose lodge and primitive showerhouse and water facilities.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Middle Tennessee Council camp facilities page, which lists it as one of the council's four owned-and-operated camps. The council spells the name 'Charles E. Parish Reservation' (the community source spelled it 'Parrish'). Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified; classified conservatively as a weekend/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
